installation.note: On many modern systems ifconfig is deprecated in favor of ip; install net-tools if you need ifconfig

overview.summary: ifconfig configures or displays network interface parameters (address, netmask, up/down). It is part of the legacy net-tools; the ip command is the modern replacement. ifconfig is still widely used in scripts and documentation.
when_to_use: View IP address and status of interfaces
Bring an interface up or down
Configure an interface (when ip is not preferred)

syntax.description: Without INTERFACE, ifconfig lists all interfaces. With INTERFACE, it configures or shows that interface.

examples.title: List interfaces
examples.description: Show all interfaces with addresses and status

examples.title: Bring interface up
examples.use_case: After enabling a link or cable

related_commands.description: Modern replacement: ip addr, ip link (prefer on new systems)
